name: Aes67StreamListAgent
comment: Agent that maintains a catalog of AES67 streams available on the network. Instances shall set the inherited Purpose property to the value 'available-aes67-streams'. Strings beginning with 'oca' are reserved.

events.name: StreamAdded
events.comment: Emitted when a newly discovered stream is added to the catalog.

events.name: StreamChanged
events.comment: Emitted when metadata of an existing stream changes.

events.name: StreamRemoved
events.comment: Emitted when a previously listed stream is no longer present.

events.name: StreamsReplaced
events.comment: Emitted when the full stream catalog is replaced after a resync or source refresh.
